note: 3D water presets for the 3D Canvas shader (foundry-bridge/water/vb_water.js). Source of truth for generators/water_presets.py, the plugin panel (panel/lib/water.js) and the exported GLB extras. All lengths in feet.

flow_speed.label: Flow speed
flow_speed.hint: How fast the ripple pattern drifts (river: along the channel, slope-scaled; lake/pond/ocean: along the wind)

wave_height.label: Wave height
wave_height.hint: Strength of the light waves (how much they tilt the surface and the sun glints)

wave_scale.label: Wave scale
wave_scale.hint: Ripple wavelength (1 = about 4 ft from crest to crest)

transparency.label: Transparency
transparency.hint: 0 = nearly opaque, 1 = clear (the bed shows through, most at the banks)

depth_tint.label: Depth tint
depth_tint.hint: How much darker and bluer the water is away from the bank

foam.label: Foam
foam.hint: White foam at the shore (and crests on the ocean)

wind_dir.label: Wind direction
wind_dir.hint: Compass bearing the wind blows toward, 0 = north, 90 = east (lake, pond, ocean; a river flows along its channel)

river.label: River
river.note: Directional flow along the centreline, faster where the bed is steeper, foam at the banks

pond.label: Pond
pond.note: Calm, small ripples, clear and still

lake.label: Lake
lake.note: Broader gentle waves driven by the wind, a little shore foam

ocean.label: Ocean
ocean.note: Long swells, whitecaps and shore foam, wind driven
